title: Apple Silicon Thermals
stale: Sensor readings expired. Manual controls are disabled until fresh data arrives.
writeFailed: Could not change fan control. The safety service will attempt automatic recovery.
writeTimeout: Fan command timed out. The safety service will attempt firmware automatic control.
heartbeatFailed: Fan control stopped responding. The safety service will attempt firmware automatic control.
unsupported: This widget requires Apple Silicon hardware running Linux.
driverMissing: The macsmc_hwmon driver is unavailable. This does not mean this Mac is fanless.
sensorNote: These sensors do not measure CPU or GPU die temperature.
setup: Monitoring only. Install the optional control service to enable manual fan speeds.
leaseNote: Your selected RPM stays active while this widget is running. Auto restores firmware control. If control or sensor monitoring fails, the safety service attempts automatic recovery.
